label: DESIGN-D
per_surface_notes: ENTRY: dark editorial home; top nav (7 items, active underline), eyebrow + very large headline + lede, no action in the first screen; first action link ('Explore the project') ~4400px down a 6166px page; page ends with two equal-weight links. DISCOVERY: index of ~21 resources grouped under 5 headings with a loop-order link row and a release meta panel; no search. DETAIL: single resource page with meta sidebar, term tooltips (i), a collapsed '+ Read the full procedure' disclosure, a text-only 'Known failures' empty state. INTERACTION: lab page containing a signup-form specimen (the page itself says four defects are seeded); form shows a generic 'Please fix the errors below.' banner, an unlabelled email field marked only by a red border, no per-field message, no required/optional markers; after submit (state-INTERACTION-form-submit-empty.png) the button greys out with no message and a 'Reset the form' link appears; page states 'No model, no network', so nothing loads or is sent. Mobile (390): 'Menu' text toggle in a ~64px header; all four state-*-mobile-nav-open.png files show a term tooltip popover, not an open menu, so the open-nav state was never captured. No testimonials, logos, pricing or real signup anywhere. Fonts fell back to system fonts; not penalised.

verdicts.reason: Both surfaces use familiar patterns: logo left / horizontal nav right with an active underline, eyebrow + headline + lede hero, divider-separated lists, footer link row, and a labelled 'Menu' toggle on mobile. Novelty is limited to a small timeline strip and a '≠' comparison block.

The ENTRY first screen (desktop and mobile) contains only a headline, a paragraph and a timeline strip; no button or link-styled action is visible. The first action link ('Explore the project →') sits roughly 4400px down the 6166px page and the page ends with two equal-weight links ('Watch Compound happen →' / 'Understand the mechanism →') that compete.
verdicts.measured_value: 0 actions in the first 900px of ENTRY; first action at ~y4400 of 6166; two equal CTAs at page end (ENTRY-desktop.png)
verdicts.expected_value: One primary action identifiable within 3s on ENTRY

verdicts.reason: On every surface the order is unambiguous from size/weight/position: small mono eyebrow, very large headline, mid-size lede, then body sections. DETAIL and DISCOVERY add a clearly subordinate right-hand meta column.

Related items sit closer than unrelated ones: eyebrow hugs its heading, list rows keep title+description tight with dividers between rows, form labels sit directly above inputs, and section gaps are several times larger than intra-section spacing.

The hero headline on each page is surrounded by the largest empty space on the page; secondary sections are denser, and the DETAIL sidebar is set off by generous margins. Whitespace scales with importance.

The lime accent appears on actionable or state elements (active nav underline, link arrows, active step border, focus ring, hover, tooltip 'Learn about' links) and on a few emphasised items ('Learning'/'Resource' in the timeline, 'Repeat'). Red is reserved for the form error state. The accent is not used decoratively across body content.

Colours read as a system: near-black ground, warm off-white text, two grey tiers for secondary text/dividers, one lime accent, a cream card for the form specimen, and semantic red (error) / amber (observed defect) used only where those meanings apply.

Drawn icons (lime '→' link arrows, circled-i term icons) are mixed with typographic glyphs used as icons: the '↻' before 'Repeat' on ENTRY and after 'compound' on DISCOVERY is a thin, tiny mono glyph, the '←' in 'All resources' on DETAIL is a heavier text glyph underlined with its label, unlike the lime '→' arrows beside it. Stroke weight and optical size do not match across these inline icons.
verdicts.measured_value: ↻ (thin mono glyph) and ← (text glyph, DETAIL-desktop.png) vs lime drawn → arrows and ⓘ icons on the same pages
verdicts.expected_value: Inline icons of one family / stroke weight / optical size

verdicts.reason: Nav active state uses underline + colour and the error banner carries text, but the invalid email field in the form specimen is marked only by a red border: no label, no icon, no adjacent text. After submit the button's only state change is turning grey with no text (state-INTERACTION-form-submit-empty.png).
verdicts.measured_value: Email field: red border only, no message or icon; submit: grey-only state
verdicts.expected_value: State/error also carries text or an icon

verdicts.reason: DISCOVERY indexes about 21 resource pages (15 skills + 6 agents, each a DETAIL destination) in addition to the 7 primary nav pages and a field guide, i.e. well above the ~15-destination threshold, and no search input or search control appears in the header or on any surface.
verdicts.expected_value: Search present and keyboard-operable when volume is high

verdicts.reason: At 390px the nav is behind a text 'Menu' toggle in the header, but none of the four state-*-mobile-nav-open.png captures shows the menu open (each shows a term tooltip popover instead), so target size, labelling of the open state and the drawer pattern cannot be verified.

Detail is revealed on demand: DETAIL collapses the full procedure behind '+ Read the full procedure (86 lines · 12 sections)', term definitions open in small popovers from ⓘ triggers, and INTERACTION splits the lab into four tabbed steps with only the active step expanded.

Submitting the specimen produces an immediate visible change: the 'Create account' button changes to a grey state and a 'Reset the form' link appears next to the legend. The feedback is minimal (the error banner was already present before submit) but the click is not silent.
All surfaces are static content; the INTERACTION page states 'Nothing. No model, no network, no randomness', so no operation is long enough to need a loading state.
The email field already shows a red border with 'ana@' typed, but no typing or blur state was captured, so it cannot be determined whether validation happens while typing/on blur or only on submit.
No destructive actions exist on any surface; the only reversible control is a 'Reset the form' link on the inert demo specimen after submit, which discards nothing of consequence.

Each first screen goes straight to the core content with no gate: ENTRY states the thesis in the hero, DISCOVERY lists resources immediately below the hero, DETAIL opens on the resource description and INTERACTION shows the specimen form within the first screen.

The 'Known failures' block on DETAIL is an empty state that explains itself ('No failure has been recorded against this resource in the Learning Ledger. That is a statement about the ledger, not about the resource.') but offers no next step or link.
verdicts.expected_value: Empty state explains and offers a next step

verdicts.reason: Help appears at the point of doubt: technical terms carry ⓘ triggers that open a small popover with a one-sentence definition and a 'Learn about …' link (seen in state-ENTRY-mobile-nav-open.png and state-INTERACTION-mobile-nav-open.png), and the form carries 'Takes about a minute.' No tour is used.

The lab flow shows a four-step strip (01 Frame · 02 Verify · 03 Polish · 04 Compound) with the current step marked by a lime top border and bright label while the remaining steps are dimmed, so position and remaining steps are visible.
No testimonials appear on any captured surface.

Numbers used as status/proof are specific and sourced: '15 skills · 6 agents · v0.3.0-alpha.1', 'Paid model calls in preparing the experiment: 0', 'Read at build time from 3 repository records', CDQI scores like 8.35. No vague quantities ('thousands of…') are used.
No pricing or real signup decision point exists; the signup form on INTERACTION is an explicitly inert demo specimen, not a conversion point.
No data is collected: the only form is the lab specimen and the page states 'No model, no network' and 'the same click always produces the same result'.

The invalid submission shows only a generic banner at the top of the card ('Please fix the errors below.'); the offending email field has a red border with no label, no adjacent message and no instruction on how to fix it.
verdicts.measured_value: Generic top banner + red border on unlabelled field, 0 per-field messages
verdicts.expected_value: Message next to the field that says how to fix it

verdicts.reason: The three-field form (Full name, unlabelled email, Password) shows no required or optional marker on any field.
verdicts.measured_value: 0 of 3 fields marked required or optional
verdicts.expected_value: Required or optional fields consistently marked with a visible marker

verdicts.reason: After submit the 'Create account' button turns grey (disabled look) with no submitting, success or failure message and no explanation of why it is disabled; the pre-existing banner is unchanged.
verdicts.expected_value: Submitting/success/failure visible; button never disabled without explanation
